_comment: corral demo world — S2/S3. Field names are the real corral-common DTO names (osVersion, not os), because this binds straight to Device. Every human-readable name carries (demo): a demo device must never be mistakable for a real one. An emulator that has not booted carries no avd — exactly like a real one, where `adb -s S emu avd name` cannot answer until it is online — so the AVD that owns it is declared in `avds` (serial/model/osVersion) and `avd start` is what brings it into the pool booting.
